subject: Science
description: Beads on a string: DNA wound around histone protein cores, joined by linker DNA
alt: A row of four nucleosomes: DNA wound twice around each histone protein core, with short linker DNA between them
prompt: Four IDENTICAL nucleosomes in a horizontal row, like beads on a string. Each is a histone core drawn as a rounded cluster of lobes in one single light orange-yellow colour, the same shape, size and colour for all four cores. A blue-teal DNA strand is wound about twice around each core, and a short linker stretch of the same DNA strand joins each nucleosome to the next. The only orange in the picture is the four histone cores; the DNA is blue/teal.
checklist: four nucleosomes, all four drawn identically, including the colour of the histone core
DNA is wound around each core about two turns and continues as linker DNA between cores
the DNA strand is continuous from the first to the last nucleosome
